goal:
Create src/lib/regionClassifier.ts and src/lib/regionClassifier.test.ts.

PURPOSE: map a 3D click point on a patient mesh to a body-region id. The patient is in normalized app space: feet at y=0, top of head at y=1.8, facing +z, patient's RIGHT side at NEGATIVE x (mirrored: screen-left is the patient's right). Arms hang at the sides.

EXPORT 1: export type BodyRegion = 'face' | 'head' | 'neck-cspine' | 'chest' | 'abdomen' | 'pelvis' | 'right-arm' | 'left-arm' | 'right-leg' | 'left-leg';

EXPORT 2: export interface RegionHit { region: BodyRegion; foot: boolean; }

EXPORT 3: export function classifyBodyPoint(x: number, y: number, z: number): RegionHit

CLASSIFICATION RULES (apply in this exact order):
1. If y >= 1.72: region 'head' (crown/top). foot=false.
2. Else if y >= 1.50: 'face' when z >= 0.02 (front of the head), otherwise 'head' (back/sides). foot=false.
3. Else if y >= 1.40: 'neck-cspine'. foot=false.
4. Else if y >= 0.78 AND |x| > 0.13: an arm — 'right-arm' when x < 0, 'left-arm' when x > 0. foot=false. (Arms hang from shoulder ~1.40 down to hands ~0.78; the torso half-width is ~0.13.)
5. Else if y >= 1.13: 'chest'. foot=false.
6. Else if y >= 0.93: 'abdomen'. foot=false.
7. Else if y >= 0.80: 'pelvis'. foot=false.
8. Else (y < 0.80): a leg — 'right-leg' when x < 0, 'left-leg' when x >= 0. foot = (y < 0.09). (Feet are the bottom 9cm.)

Code style: pure function, no imports needed, JSDoc on the exported function explaining the coordinate space in one paragraph, no classes, no console.

TESTS (vitest, import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'): at least 14 assertions covering: forehead front point (0, 1.62, 0.16) -> face; back of head (0, 1.62, -0.1) -> head; crown (0, 1.75, 0) -> head; neck (0, 1.45, 0.1) -> neck-cspine; sternum (0, 1.25, 0.18) -> chest; belly (0.03, 1.0, 0.2) -> abdomen; pelvis (0, 0.85, 0.2) -> pelvis; right wrist (-0.2, 0.82, 0.15) -> right-arm; left mid-arm (0.3, 1.1, 0) -> left-arm; right thigh (-0.1, 0.5, 0.1) -> right-leg with foot=false; left shin (0.12, 0.25, 0.1) -> left-leg foot=false; right foot (-0.13, 0.05, 0.15) -> right-leg foot=true; left foot (0.13, 0.03, 0.1) -> left-leg foot=true; boundary: y exactly 0.09 is NOT a foot.
verify: npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && npx vitest run src/lib/regionClassifier.test.ts
